$comment: HAND-OWNED. Tests the drizzle-e2e lane does not run, one array per dialect. Every entry carries a reason, and the reasons come in two kinds: what drizzle itself skips for the same driver, and where OUR boundary genuinely differs. A translated test that fails and is NOT listed here is a real recorder bug — add the FIX, not a row. run-suite.mjs REFUSES an entry that names no test in the vendored suite, so a stale row cannot sit here pretending to skip something.

mysql.reason: the lane vendors a SUBSET of drizzle's suite tree (the three driver-agnostic <dialect>-common.ts files and their two helpers), and this test reads migration files from a drizzle2/ folder that is not part of it. Nothing to do with the recorders; drizzle's own pg runner skips its migrator tests for its own reasons too.

sqlite.reason: better-sqlite3 is a SYNCHRONOUS driver and rejects an async transaction callback ("Transaction function cannot return a promise"). Nothing to do with the recorders: drizzle skips two of these itself for the same driver, and the other two fail in better-sqlite3s own transaction wrapper.
